# Omnilib
> Daily AI & tech news, insights, and analysis — plus a curated directory of 850+ AI tools. The blog is the heart of the site, covering AI model releases, tool launches, industry trends, regulation, and practical guides.

## Blog (home page)
- Daily AI & tech news at / (individual posts at /blog/{slug})
- Topics: AI news, tool launches, tutorials, industry analysis, research
- RSS feed at /blog/rss.xml
- Covers: AI model releases, tool comparisons, industry trends, regulation, practical guides

## AI Tools Directory
- Comprehensive directory of 850+ AI tools at /tools
- Each tool has: name, description, pricing, rating, category, tags, screenshots
- Tools are organized by category and searchable by name, description, or tag
- Affiliate links for each tool at /go/{slug}
- Tool detail pages at /tool/{slug}

## API
- GET /api/blog - List blog posts (supports ?page=, ?category=, ?tag=, ?q=)
- GET /api/blog/{slug} - Get single blog post
- GET /api/tools - List all tools (supports ?q=, ?category=, ?pricing=, ?tag=, ?sort=)
- GET /api/tools/{slug} - Get single tool details
- GET /api/categories - List all categories
- GET /sitemap.xml - Full sitemap
- GET /blog/rss.xml - Blog RSS feed

## Categories
Blog: AI News, Tool Launches, Tutorials, Industry, Research
Tools: Chatbots, Image Generation, Writing, Coding, Video, Audio & Music, Productivity, Research, Design, Marketing
